articles.title: Consensys to split MetaMask into its own firm while staying silent on IPO
articles.snippet: The existing company, Consensys Software Inc., will rebrand as MetaMask under Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin as chairman and CEO.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the 300-to-1 onchain gap between the dollar and euro
articles.snippet: Ryan Connor of RockawayX writes that the dollar leads the euro about 3 to 1 across the offchain economy and more than 300 to 1 onchain. Euro-pegged stablecoins total €711 million, under 1% of supply. He traces the gap to path dependency and missing euro DeFi infrastructure, and argues MiCA-regulated issuance and euro vault rails are changing it.

articles.title: PayPal expands stablecoin rails with custom token issuance platform
articles.snippet: The PYUSDx stablecoin developer platform, backed by PayPal USD (PYUSD), is built with the help of M0 and MoonPay.

articles.title: Hunter Biden's new LAPTOP token lost 98% of its value in under an hour after $1.6 billion debut
articles.snippet: LAPTOP swung from $190 to under $4 within minutes of opening on Base. Onchain records show tokens had been distributed to market makers for a week before trading began.

articles.title: Algorand names former Chainlink executive William Herkelrath as CEO
articles.snippet: The former Chainlink and Curv executive will lead the blockchain organization’s push into institutional finance and quantum-resistant security.
